watch.readinessNote: The connector is a UE4SS mod (Lua reflection plus a small C++ WebSocket DLL) inside SCUMServer.exe, proven on game 1.3.4.2.161892 (Steam build 25803875) with UE4SS v3.0.1-1181-g83330635. It names game classes and functions, not code addresses, so a new build usually keeps working, but every new build needs a live retest before it is declared.

mod.description: The release zip unpacked into SCUM/Binaries/Win64: the pinned UE4SS loader (dwmapi.dll + ue4ss/) with the required hook settings and the TakaroSCUM mod (Lua scripts + dlls/main.dll), which holds the Takaro connection itself; no sidecar
